text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the lead in organizing our ramen 
training in Niigata.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first stop on our "Ramen Training 
Journey." On the bullet train bound for 
Niigata, Calstone Light O boldly declared 
her intentions.
choice_data_list: I think that's fine, but... why?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"There are no 'no matter whats' about it. 
Have you forgotten our objective?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
With the year-end 'Ramen Jamboree' in 
mind, we've decided to tour regions with 
local racetracks.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Ramen ascetic training," in other words! 
We travel far and wide to learn what makes 
ramen so captivating and incorporate it—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's also an event to show off the fruits 
of our training and just have a grand old 
time.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The stage for the first stop on that 
journey was—Niigata. And when you think of 
Niigata, you think of the 1,000-meter 
straight.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"You've noticed by now, haven't you? When 
it comes to straightaways, it's all about 
me. Could it be anyone else? Of course 
not. Rhetorical question."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So, I'll be taking the lead. ...Oh, it 
seems we still have some time before we 
arrive.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Zzz. Sleeping peacefully.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Incredible! So this is the rumored 
straight course! It seems like maintaining 
top speed is going to be the key!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? Where's the girl who said 
she'd run things?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ALRIGHT, LET'S RUN, WOOOOOOOAAAAAAAHHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No no no no no no!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the 1000m straight, I couldn't 
resist and sprinted through the paddock 
tunnel at top speed. I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Still... Niigata is an even more 
wonderful place than I had imagined!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Aside from the straight course at Niigata 
Racecourse, you might even get to see the 
rare crested ibis—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The tub boat was exceedingly thrilling as 
well. I couldn't stop shouting 'Hyah-hoo!' 
in sheer excitement; I must have cried it 
out at least twelve times.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—Ah. A sudden flash of intuition just hit 
me. If we incorporate these features into 
ramen—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's ready. Just try it first. No ifs, 
ands, or buts.
choice_data_list: I hadn't even said anything yet, though...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, it's delicious! But... huh? 
*slurp*, *slurp*... The noodles, they 
aren't ending...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I call it '1000m Straightaway Ramen.' 
There's only one noodle. Making it 1000 
meters was a bit much, so it's 1000 
centimeters long.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: How is it? Hard to eat, isn't it?
choice_data_list: You knew that and still did it!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Next is over there: the 'Toki Ramen'. I 
shaped the noodles like an ibis. Well, 
they're more like sheets than noodles at 
this point, though.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: How is it? Hard to eat, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Light O-san? Normally, if you think 
something looks hard to eat, wouldn't you 
stop developing it right there?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Heh. You don't get it, Nature. If I could 
stop there, I wouldn't be me.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Lastly, we have the 'Washbasin Ramen.' 
Because it uses a large washbasin as a 
bowl, the noodles and soup seem unusually 
scant, but this is one full serving. 
Please enjoy."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. All right. I'll say it. It's up 
to me to lay down the law here.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Making it completely identical isn't the 
point, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I think taking on challenges is totally 
fine! I mean, that's what this training 
journey is all about anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Still... how should I put it? It feels 
like we might need to stay aware of *why* 
we're making ramen, in a sense..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...You want to properly return what the 
fans gave you and make them happy, right?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"So, with that perspective in mind, I 
wonder if we need to incorporate the 
charms of Niigata, too~"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, I'm so sorry! I didn't mean to 
sound so bossy and know-it-all!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No, you're right. Nature makes a good 
point. I shouldn't let this get me down. 
—Alright, I'm back on track.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Make ramen that delights the fans in 
Niigata— that was the purpose of my 
training journey. Yeah, now I remember.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hm? All that studying made me hungry. 
Let's eat! Food time! Food time!
choice_data_list:
O-Ohh... Well then, shall we grab some 
lunch?!

Y-yeah... Well then, shall we grab some 
lunch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I had lunch with Calstone Light O 
and the others at a restaurant in Niigata. 
Then—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
R-Right, exactly?! It's so delicious! With 
every bite, the sweetness just bursts 
out!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Aren't they getting a bit too worked up 
over mere rice? How overdramatic. There's 
no way it could be that much different 
from what we eat in the cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So good! What is with this rice?! It's 
completely different from what I usually 
eat!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Even though the food at the academy is 
already super delicious! How does this 
rice surpass even that?! There's got to be 
a secret. Definitely!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'll go look into it! Straight ahead, 
straight aheeead!!
choice_data_list: Aah!? Wait, where are you going... !?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, found you! Right O-chan! What are you 
doing in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I was interviewing a rice farmer. They 
said Niigata rice is so delicious it's 
almost absurd."

text_block_list.name: Rice Farmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's so kind of you! Hearing that 
makes all the hard work totally worth it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Farmer
text_block_list.text:
Niigata's rice has quite a history, you 
know. Through endless selective breeding 
and improving irrigation and drainage 
channels—

text_block_list.name: Rice Farmer
text_block_list.text:
This land wasn't able to grow "delicious 
rice" right from the start. We worked hard 
and became good at rice farming.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see. So that's why it was so delicious. 
A wonderful effort. *applause*

text_block_list.name: Rice Farmer
text_block_list.text: By the way, what variety did you eat?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I don't know. I left the shop before I 
could ask.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, if it's about that, I already asked! 
If I recall—"

text_block_list.name: Rice Farmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's an extra-early ripening 
variety.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Extremely early-maturing!? What kind of 
fast-sounding variety is that?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Farmer
text_block_list.text:
Just as the name suggests, it's a variety 
harvested earlier than regular rice, 
allowing it to be sold as new rice from 
around late August.

text_block_list.name: Rice Farmer
text_block_list.text:
Freshly harvested rice usually hits the 
market between September and November, but 
extremely early-ripening rice can be 
shipped as early as August.

text_block_list.name: Rice Farmer
text_block_list.text:
We want to deliver delicious freshly 
harvested rice to consumers as quickly as 
possible. This rice was bred and produced 
with that exact wish in mind.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I see. Got it. Understood.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
First bonito over ordinary bonito. 
First-flush green tea over second or third 
harvest.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
And bean sprouts are like that too. I 
always thought it was unnatural for 
something to be so delicious when it can 
be harvested in just a week—but it's not.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
When food's this good, the sooner you eat 
it, the tastier it is!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to waste. Thank you very 
much, rice farmers. Excuse me! Hyaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOOHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Make the soup at top speed, boil the 
noodles at top speed, and drain the 
noodles at top speed! If I do this――

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Done. I drained the noodles at maximum 
speed, which completely pulverized them 
into ramen dust!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"...??? Isn't this where the ultimate 
ramen is made?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe we're focusing on the wrong 
part to make faster!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The people of Niigata created "extremely 
early-ripening rice" to deliver delicious 
freshly harvested rice sooner. So maybe 
it's that spirit we should follow...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone-chan, what does 'speed' mean to 
you when it comes to ramen?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: That's...—Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Craving ramen. Waiting in line at the 
shop. Buying a meal ticket. Taking a seat. 
Waiting for it to be served—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—During that wait, you start thinking 
'it's taking too long.' Your ramen craving 
drops. The deliciousness drops.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: So, if it were me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the day of the "Warrior Training 
Event" in Niigata arrived.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Welcome in! Here's some soup to start 
with!!

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What?! They gave us soup before we 
even ordered!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Next, please place your order for the 
course!

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Course meal? Well then, I'll have... the 
"All-You-Can-Eat Full-Belly Course"...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Here are your noodles~! Enjoy your 
first bowl~!

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wha... The noodles are already here!? 
What? Can I eat them already? Things are 
moving a bit too fast...!

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
*Slurp...* Ah, it's so light and tasty! 
There aren't many noodles, but they go 
down so smooth—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: H-Here's your second cup~!

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text: A second bowl, already?!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Behold, aptly named: 'Top-Speed Ramen'! 
Ta-da!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"...I was amazed when I ate the 
early-harvest rice in Niigata. By its 
delicious flavor, and by the spirit behind 
delivering it so quickly."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I should follow that example. 
So, I made one too."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ramen that you can eat the exact moment 
you crave it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Now, feel it for yourself. That being the 
fastest is the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooh!" "So that's the concept!" "Hehe, 
it's just so like her..." "Delicious!" 
"The best!" "Another cup!"
choice_data_list:
(Great! Looks like the response is 
excellent!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, caught up by the smiling 
fans, my own cheeks had relaxed into a 
grin as well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Our first warrior training event was 
a complete success!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. So this is how warrior training is 
done. I've got the hang of it in record 
time. Next time will be a breeze.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Um, excuse me, sorry to bother you. 
It's about that ramen from earlier...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Isn't that wanko soba?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: No. It's 'Speediest Ramen'!!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You really insisted on that!!?
